+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+DEFAULT_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def extract_layout(document_bytes: bytes, mime_type: str = "application/pdf", model: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    model_name = model or DEFAULT_MODEL
+    payload = {
+        "model": model_name,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_text",
+                        "text": "Extract the document layout as structured JSON with blocks, lines, tables, and other layout elements.",
+                    },
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_image",
+                        "image_url": f"data:{mime_type};base64,{document_bytes.decode('latin1')}"
+                        if mime_type.startswith("image/")
+                        else {"type": "input_text", "text": "Document bytes provided separately."},
+                    },
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
+    }
+
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(OPENAI_API_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=120)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: extract_text.py
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Union
+from urllib import request as urllib_request
+from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
+
+
+OPENAI_VISION_MODEL = os.environ.get("OPENAI_VISION_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+
+
+def _load_image_bytes(image: Union[str, bytes, Path]) -> bytes:
+    if isinstance(image, bytes):
+        return image
+    return Path(image).read_bytes()
+
+
+def _to_data_url(image_bytes: bytes, mime_type: str = "image/png") -> str:
+    return f"data:{mime_type};base64,{base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode('ascii')}"
+
+
+def extract_text(image: Union[str, bytes, Path], api_key: Optional[str] = None, mime_type: str = "image/png") -> str:
+    key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": OPENAI_VISION_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": "Extract all plain text from this scanned document image. Return only the text."},
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": _to_data_url(_load_image_bytes(image), mime_type)},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+
+    req = urllib_request.Request(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        method="POST",
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with urllib_request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as resp:
+            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    except HTTPError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"OpenAI API error: {exc.read().decode('utf-8', 'ignore')}") from exc
+    except URLError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Network error: {exc.reason}") from exc
+
+    output_text = data.get("output_text")
+    if isinstance(output_text, str) and output_text.strip():
+        return output_text.strip()
+
+    texts = []
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"} and content.get("text"):
+                texts.append(content["text"])
+    return "\n".join(texts).strip()
+
+
+__all__ = ["extract_text", "OPENAI_VISION_MODEL", "OPENAI_API_URL"]
*** End Patch
